intro: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic is a quest given by High Sorcerer Andromath in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind. He charges adventurers with recovering a forbidden, magically sealed tome from the renegade mage Morganth, who fled with it to the Tower of Ilgalar in the Redridge Mountains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Long ago, three mages studied in this tower until one fell to the dark arts. He was urged to turn away from that evil magic, but he could not resist. And so he was banished.
The fallen mage's new domain is the tower of Ilgalar in Redridge, and he took with him a powerful book—Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic.
We, the mages of Stormwind, would have that book returned. Enter the tower of Ilgalar, find the tome in his library, and bring it to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the book, friend? Its secrets are not meant for the untrained, and plumbing its depths can lead to doom and ruin.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I feared that Morganth had hidden the book elsewhere, or that he had found a way to open it and read its contents.
It is good to see that he did not, and that the seals we placed on Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic still hold.
